transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I'm here because people keep acting like I'm just imagining it. But I'm not. I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house. They watch my cleaning routes, too... just to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband.
Do you think these people are watching you for a specific reason?

I... I thought I just said. They want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. That's why they watch the house, and... and check on me when I'm working. I don't really know what else you want me to say about it.
Do you think these people watching you are trying to harm you or your husband in any way?

Harm? No, I... I didn't say anything about them hurting us. 

Like I already told you, people keep acting like this is all in my head. But the hospital and the agency... they're just keeping tabs on the house and my routes. Just judging if I'm caring for him right. That's all.
Do you think there's any possibility that you might be mistaken about the hospital and agency watching you?

No. I'm not mistaken. People keep saying I'm just imagining it, but... I know what I see. The hospital people, the agency... they're watching the house. They watch my cleaning routes. They just want to see if I'm taking proper care of him. That's... that's just what's happening. I don't know why everyone keeps asking me if I'm sure.
Do you think the hospital and agency are working together to watch you?

I don't know if they're... working together. I just know they're both doing it. The hospital people, the agency folks... they're both keeping tabs. Like I said, I'm just here because everyone keeps acting like I'm making it up. But they are watching. Both of them. Just... watching to see if I'm caring for him right. That's all I know.
Do you think there are other people besides those from the hospital and agency who are watching you or your husband?
No. Just them. I haven't... I haven't seen anyone else. Just the ones I already told you about.
Do you think the hospital and agency's actions are related to anything specific you've done or anything about your husband?
I don't know. I just... I told you, they're checking if I'm taking care of him right. I don't know why they picked us. They just did.
Do you think the hospital and agency's watching is part of a larger plan or scheme?

I don't know about any scheme. I... I just know what I see. Like I keep saying, I'm only here because everyone acts like I'm imagining it. But they watch our house. And... even when I'm at work, on my cleaning routes, I know they're watching. Just to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. That's all.
Do you think there's anything you could do to stop the hospital and agency from watching you?
I don't know. I... I don't think so. I just try to keep my head down and... and do things right for him. I don't know what else they want from me.
Do you believe the hospital and agency are watching you because they think you're not taking good enough care of your husband, or is there another reason?

I don't know about any other reason. I... I already told you. They just want to see if I'm taking proper care of him. People keep acting like I'm just imagining it all, but... I know the hospital people and the agency folks are watching our house. And my cleaning routes. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you ever had a time when you didn't think the hospital and agency were watching you?

No. Not really. I... I feel like I just keep repeating myself. Like I said, I'm only here because people act like I'm imagining it all. But I know the hospital people and the agency folks have been watching our house. And my cleaning routes. Just to see about my husband. That's... that's just how it is. I don't know what else to say about it.
Do you think the hospital and agency's watching is limited to just your husband's care or is it part of something bigger involving you or your life in general?

I don't know about anything bigger. It's... it's just what I said. They watch the house and my routes to see if I'm taking proper care of him. I'm only here because people keep acting like I'm making it all up. I... I really don't have anything else to say about it.
Do you think the hospital and agency's watching of you is part of a single plan or idea that explains everything that's happening to you?

I... I don't know about any plan. I just... I keep telling you. I'm only here because everyone acts like I'm imagining things. But I know they're watching. The hospital people, the agency folks... they watch the house. They watch my cleaning routes. It's just to see if I'm taking care of my husband. That's... that's all it is. I really don't want to keep talking about this.
Have you ever had any doubts about the hospital and agency watching you?

No. I don't. I... I feel like we just keep going in circles. 

Like I've been saying, I'm only sitting here because people act like I'm imagining it all. But I don't have doubts. I know the hospital people and those folks from the agency watch our house... and my cleaning routes. They just want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. I know what I see. I... I really don't want to keep going over this.
Have your thoughts about the hospital and agency watching you ever changed since you first noticed it?

No. They haven't. It's... it's always been the same. I'm just here because everyone thinks I'm making it up. But I know they watch the house and my routes. The hospital and the agency. They're checking on how I care for my husband. That's... that's it. Nothing's changed.
Do you think the hospital and agency's actions are connected to each other in some way?

I... I don't know if they talk to each other. I just... I know what they're doing. Like I said, they watch the house and my cleaning routes. The hospital and the agency. They're just making sure I'm taking care of him. I don't know why everyone acts like I'm crazy for seeing it.
Do you think the hospital and agency's belief that you're not taking good enough care of your husband is based on any actual evidence or observations they've made?

I... I don't know about evidence. I just know what they're doing. 

I'm only here because people keep acting like I'm imagining it all. But I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house... and my cleaning routes. They're just watching to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. I really don't have anything else to say about it.
Do you think the hospital and agency watching you is connected to any other ideas or beliefs you have?
No. I don't... I don't know what you mean by that. It's just what I said. They watch the house. That's all it is.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe the hospital and agency were watching you?

I... I guess there was a quieter spell. For a few weeks. I was sleeping a lot more, just... not rushing around as much. 

But... no. I still knew the agency was watching us. And I still heard that voice by the kitchen window. So... no. It hasn't stopped.
